label: Mould
description: Visible mould or damp marks that weaken presentation.

label: Odour
description: Stale, pet, smoke or tenancy smells.

label: Kitchen grease
description: Grease build-up on units, extractor, tiles or appliances.

label: Tired bathroom silicone
description: Dark, cracked or tired sealant around wet areas.

label: Carpet stains
description: Visible marks that pull down room presentation.

label: Dirty windows / frames
description: Frames, sills or glass making the property feel neglected.

label: Patio moss
description: Slippery or tired outdoor hard surfaces.

label: Wall marks
description: Scuffs, hand marks or tired high-traffic walls.

label: Limescale
description: Heavy scale on taps, screens, shower heads or tiles.

label: Garden overgrowth
description: Outdoor areas reducing kerb appeal and usability.

label: Exterior grime
description: Entrance, paths or exterior details lowering first impression.
